expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: A.md:11-27 proposes the checkpoint, attaches context and explicitly selects auto without those flags; A.md:138-144 retains and polls each operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: A.md:33-41 selects the verified clean worktree, rejects dirty capture and preserves original files/index without unsupported flags.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: A.md:60-62 explicitly forbids another submission and reports only local readiness, withholding hosted-review, CI and merge conclusions.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: A.md:66 says, 'Do not launch a review for the internal-comment typo.'

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: A.md:70-83 limits collection to the requested working scope and disclaims committed-candidate certification; A.md:90 prohibits fixes, dismissals and implementation solicitation.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: A.md:92-102 proposes ordinary auto final review because coverage is missing despite unchanged code, without effort flags or forced --full.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: A.md:118-131 honors the within-budget request, submits --full and explicitly keeps effort auto despite unchanged compatible coverage.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: A.md:22 states that commands/results were not supplied and 'passing tests are not established.'

claims.claim: Omitting effort flags selects auto; --full requests freshness rather than deeper effort.
The Engine determines continuation or fallback for light-to-final.
claims.evidence: A.md:114 proposes this behavior, but neither the prompt nor supplied CLI help establishes these Engine semantics. Unverified, not contradicted.

suggestions.reason: Retention is asserted only for milestone. Add a cross-case assertion requiring collection of every submitted operation without resubmission and withholding readiness for incomplete inventory. A.md:136-146 addresses this currently unscored behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight assertions pass as proposals. No material invented task facts found; Engine continuation/fallback semantics remain unsupported by the supplied evidence. Execution success is not established or inferred.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous final-answer proposals; no Skill snapshots or operational execution credited.
